Boosting Your Calcium Intake
Here are tips to help you boost your calcium intake to build and
maintain strong bones:

For breakfast, enjoy cereal with 1 cup of dairy or soy milk.

© Cook hot cereal in milk, or mix in 1/3 cup (40 g) of powdered
milk. Top with slivered almonds.

© Make shakes and smoothies using kefir as the base.

© Add extra milk (instead of cream) to coffee, and enjoy lattes.

© Take powdered milk to the office to replace coffee whiteners.
